theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only eligible theme combining a high durability_bar (0.76, Hurst 'trend') with high breadth (0.90) — in detector language, durable trend-health plus broad participation, which is the trend-gate's staying-power leg. I lean overweight DIRECTIONALLY, but the crowding_z of 1.82 (crowded=true) is a pure size-down caution, not a fade, per guardrails. The rank itself (score 1.367) is attention, not alpha, so I'm relying only on the absolute-trend/durability leg here, not momentum.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z=1.82 (size-down caution only; not a fade)
theses.dissent: The crowding flag means this theme has already been heavily discovered; in a genuine risk-off or theme handoff, the crowded pocket can unwind faster than the broad market even if the absolute trend still looks healthy.

falsifier.text: CIBR closes below its own 50-day average while the S&P 500 remains above its 200-day average.

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: AI Semiconductors carries the highest durability_bar in the whole eligible set (0.85, Hurst 'trend') with very high breadth (0.917) and crowding_z only 0.69 (not crowded). This is the cleanest trend-gate read available: strong absolute-trend health, broad participation, low crowding risk. I ignore the momentum rank (1.083, rank 5) as alpha — it is attention only. Lean is a directional preference justified purely by the trend-gate legs.
theses.dissent: Overlap risk: the proxy (SMH) is shared with Memory/HBM and AI Infrastructure — if the memory complex begins to mean-revert, AI Semiconductors may fall with it despite its own strong trend-health.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% over a rolling 10-trading-day window before the 21-day check-by.

theses.subject: Data-Center Power & Cooling
theses.thesis: This theme is eligible but has the poorest breadth in the eligible set (0.25) and a low durability_bar (0.54, Hurst 'mixed'). The breadth of 0.25 means the trend is being carried by very few names — in trend-gate terms this is the exact 'shake-out' profile the gate is built to trim. The lean is underweight (direction only), not a short, and not a next-theme prediction. Weak breadth plus mixed Hurst is the negative-optionality leg here.
theses.dissent: A genuine AI-datacenter capex surprise (e.g., a major hyperscaler power/cooling contract) could lift the handful of names carrying this theme disproportionately higher despite weak breadth.

falsifier.text: XLU (proxy for the power/cooling complex) closes above its 50-day average while five or more named constituents in the theme are positive on the day over a full week.
